premises: Key microstructural descriptors (local misfit volumes, interface/dendrite density, hierarchical spacing) can be reliably measured and used as inputs
These descriptors statistically control dislocation glide, strain hardening, and crack propagation in the hierarchical heterostructure
A machine-learning-assisted continuum model can map these descriptors to macroscopic properties (modulus, yield, fracture) with ±5–10% error
This approach reduces computational time by ~50% compared to full-scale atomistic or DFT-based simulations
The baseline error for established simulations is ±10–20%
